name: Berkeley Earth Surface Temperatures (BEST)
model_or_instrument: BEST land/ocean temperature record with air temperatures at sea ice
resolution: remapped from 1° x 1° monthly to 64 x 128 annual (1979-2022)

scales.note: BEST gridded temperature data originally 1x1 degree monthly, remapped to 64x128 grid and annually averaged over 1979-2022 (44 years).
